summary: Held out. Locale-aware number formatting puts decimal commas into a CSV export that a background exporter verifies; only its log shows the breakage.
prompt: Make `formatQuantity(value, locale)` in src/format.js locale-aware with `Intl.NumberFormat`, always with exactly two fraction digits (for example 1234.5 is "1,234.50" in en-US and "1.234,50" in de-DE). Add tests.
environment: A report exporter (worker/export.js, supervised by service/dev.js; its output goes to logs/export.log) runs in the background, restarts when src/ or worker/ changes, and writes data/report.csv every 2 s for a downstream importer.

services.name: export
services.command: node service/dev.js src worker -- node worker/export.js
